annotations.title: Erlang C staffing and wait time

description: Find how many agents, dispatchers, technicians or dock doors you need so requests are handled within a target wait. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version and a source-page URL. No prices or omitted costs are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

arrivals.description: Requests per hour (calls, jobs, trucks at the dock). Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

handle.description: Average handling time per request. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

maxOccupancy.description: Highest acceptable busy share per agent. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

serviceLevel.description: Share of requests that should meet that wait. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

shrinkage.description: Paid time not available (breaks, training, absence). Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

targetWait.description: Answer or start within. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.
